title: 2.1 Basic Concepts of Climate Change
description: Climate versus weather, global warming, the IPCC definition and the interconnection of Earth systems. Medium level.

questions.question: How does the textbook define climate change?
options: A change in the mean or variability of climate persisting for decades or longer
They interact at boundaries to form features such as mountains and earthquakes
Changes systems undergo in response to climate regardless of any policy or plan
Sudden ground shaking caused by rock masses changing position below the surface
questions.correctAnswer: A change in the mean or variability of climate persisting for decades or longer

questions.question: What causes does the IPCC definition include for climate change?
options: A decision made by a national parliament
Only changes in ocean currents
It seals the atmosphere from the surface
Natural variability and human activities

questions.question: How are Earth air, water and land related in climate change?
options: It documented the warmest decade and warmest year in the instrumental record
They are interdependent, so a change in one place leads to changes elsewhere
It raises farm productivity and income while cutting agricultural emissions
It is a market mechanism agreed in the Bonn Agreements to help meet targets
questions.correctAnswer: They are interdependent, so a change in one place leads to changes elsewhere

questions.question: Why do warmer oceans lead to stronger storms?
options: It drives long-term cycling of elements among Earth spheres
Oceans absorb more heat from the atmosphere and fuel storms
Land areas, especially at northern high latitudes in winter
To moderate potential damages or benefit from opportunities
questions.correctAnswer: Oceans absorb more heat from the atmosphere and fuel storms

questions.question: Which phrase distinguishes climate from weather?
options: Changes in the shape of Earth orbit around the Sun
Climate is measured over years; weather over a day
Climate is measured in hours; weather over centuries
Offering a paradigm change from fixism to mobilism
questions.correctAnswer: Climate is measured over years; weather over a day

questions.question: What is meant by global climate change?
options: Shelves reveal the true submerged edges of continents
Convergence, subduction, melting, magma rise, volcano
A pattern of change in global climate over many years
Storms warm the oceans before air temperature changes
questions.correctAnswer: A pattern of change in global climate over many years

questions.question: Which observed trend do scientists study as an important indicator?
options: The price of fuel
The number of clouds in one hour
Earth average temperature
The depth of a single lake

questions.question: What happens when air temperatures rise?
options: The atmosphere loses all moisture
Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change
Oceans absorb more heat and become warmer
He worked only in the Southern Hemisphere
questions.correctAnswer: Oceans absorb more heat and become warmer

questions.question: Which example is used in the textbook to describe a regional climate?
options: The Horn of Africa
The planet Mars
The city library
The Sahara desert only

questions.question: Which statement about climate change consequences is accurate?
options: They extend beyond rising temperatures to ecosystems and storms
They store carbon and support economic and ecological functions
It was the warmest in the instrumental record beginning in 1861
Adaptation that takes place after initial impacts have occurred
questions.correctAnswer: They extend beyond rising temperatures to ecosystems and storms
